descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S07b 「隐藏的 Rounding Sheet 能重新打开（开关打开）」 The hidden Rounding Sheet can be turned back on (flag on)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 Quick Dictation is the pad only: the separate Rounding Sheet view (patients with open tasks, today's assigned compartments, 'Needs patient') is hidden, not deleted, so it can be turned back on.（TFA-92583 AC 5；TFA-92583 AC 4；TFA-92583 AC 1）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given A second build of the same commit with VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET=true

When Run the four tests in the 'Rounding Sheet' describe of e2e/quick-dictation.spec.ts on that build

Then The sheet renders again with today's patients and its compartments, and stays out of Nursing Home

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：All four 'Rounding Sheet' tests pass with the flag on (T3, 'so it can be turned back on'). Whether a build flag counts as 'can be turned back on' is Q8. No verdict until the flag-on stack exists

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）
